children: Australian stocks look set to rise at the start of the week. Local stock futures are up by 0.4% ahead of Monday's open, suggesting the S&P/ASX 200 will continue its positive momentum from consecutive weekly gains. The benchmark index added 0.6% Friday to round out a 0.4% five-day gain, although it is still 0.8% lower in October. Ahead of the open, Cleanaway Waste Management said it extended EQT's exclusivity by a week as it works toward a takeover by the Swedish private-equity firm. Major U.S. indices rose Friday as oil prices stabilized and President Trump said Russia would supply the U.S. with diesel in a move aimed at lowering fuel prices. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
